salespeak-ai-buyer-eval-skill-root.description: An AI analyst for buying B2B software. Investigates what vendors claim, checks the evidence, surfaces contradictions and unanswered questions, and produces a shareable Decision Brief with the questions to ask before you buy. Quick Eval by default; Deep Eval on request. Use when asked to evaluate, compare, vet, or research B2B software vendors.
salespeak-ai-buyer-eval-skill-root.tools: Bash, Read, Write, WebSearch, WebFetch, AskUserQuestion
